test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The capacity of a cylindrical vessel is 25.872 litres. If the height of the cylinder is three times the radius of its base, then what is the curved surface area of the cylinder?

 (Use pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert volume: 25.872 L = 25872 cm³

Given h = 3r ⇒ Volume = πr²h = 3πr³

25872 = 3πr³ ⇒ r³ = 25872 ÷ (66/7) = 2744

r = 14 cm ⇒ h = 42 cm

CSA = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 14 × 42 = 3696 cm²

**∴ Answer = 3696 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume = 25.872 litres = 25872 cm³, h = 3r

**Formula used:**

Volume = πr²h and CSA = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume = πr²(3r) = 3πr³

⇒ 25872 = 3 × (22/7) × r³

⇒ 25872 = (66/7)r³

⇒ r³ = 25872 × 7 ÷ 66 = 2744

⇒ r = 14 cm

⇒ h = 3r = 42 cm

⇒ CSA = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 14 × 42

⇒ CSA = 3696 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 3696 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

Volume = πr²h

Curved Surface Area

CSA = 2πrh

Unit Conversion

1 litre = 1000 cm³, always convert before calculation.
